text: Flow Next 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生 agent 预设，为复杂开发任务提供任务上下文、native/PTC 界面选择、检查执行记录和阶段报告。它注册 flow_task、flow_run_check、flow_check、flow_stage 等工具，并支持将被会话压缩隐藏的人类输入作为有限历史上下文恢复。用户可关联待办、已观察的文件与检查，查看执行状态和阶段结果。适合希望在 DSH 中组织多阶段代码工作并追踪检查证据的用户；需要兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 与 Node.js 20 或更新版本，不需要额外 API 密钥。

Flow Next is a native DSH coding preset. It adds task context, native/PTC selection, check records, and stage reports. Users link todos to observed files and checks, then review results. It restores bounded human context after compaction. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and Node.js 20+; no API key.

I want useful human instructions to remain available after conversation compaction.
Flow Next 的功能「待办证据关联」：把当前原生待办关联到已观察的文件、检查记录、剩余差距和下一步行动；通过 flow_task 工具读取或记录这些关联。
Flow Next 的功能「阶段检查报告」：通过 flow_stage 查看宿主记录的各次检查状态、通过或跳过计数及待办证据缺口，并区分不同会话的历史运行。

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness：[中文](#中文说明) · [License](LICENSE) · [Compatibility and validation](docs/validation.md)

An experimental **native DSH agent preset**, combining task context, native/PTC interface selection, execution evidence, and stage reports. It preserves the host's permission system and full tool capability selection. It does not add a second model or an autonomous benchmark loop.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Flow Next for DeepSeek Harness：This is the standalone distribution of the author's Flow Next 1.8.3 mode. It is independently maintained and is not an official DeepSeek product. It is a separate project from other tools named Flow Next.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Install：Tested with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2**. The bundle declares this exact host version because DSH's preview APIs change quickly.

Open DSH's **Plugins** page, choose the external bundle installation option, and enter:

```text
https://github.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next.git#v1.8.3
```

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Install：The Plugin Manager installs and enables the bundle in the current profile. When DSH requires a restart, restart it, create a new conversation, and choose **Flow Next（试用）** before its first turn. Run `/flow-next status` to check the actual loaded version. Installing files does not migrate an existing conversation.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Install：If you already use an earlier private distribution that registers the `flow-next` preset, disable that bundle before enabling this one; both register the same preset identifier. This release does not modify an existing installation automatically.

The official CLI's `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <spec>` installs a dependency. If using that path, also select the installed bundle in the profile's Plugins page; a dependency on disk alone does not establish activation.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Use：Give it your ordinary task. It can answer a small question directly or work through repository changes using existing instructions and checks. Complex work can use the following tools and commands without turning every answer into a report:

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Use：| Surface | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `flow_select` | Choose native tools or PTC for a later request boundary while retaining full capabilities. |
| `flow_task` | Link native task entries to observed artifacts, checks, gaps, and a next action. |
| `flow_run_check` | Execute one check with explicit inputs and expected names through native execution and permission controls. |
| `flow_check` | Inspect execution observations; retain prospective scope, coverage declarations, and explanations. |
| `flow_stage` | Read a stage report, keeping failures, skips, disabled and unknown results distinct. |
| `/flow-next status` | Show the loaded version, current interface, and switch budget. |
| `/flow-next report`, `task`, `history`, `stage` | Read the relevant retained state without requesting a model response. |

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Use：A recorded zero exit, an agent's coverage declaration, and product acceptance remain different claims. The plugin cannot certify semantic correctness, visual quality, or that every relevant test was selected. Historical observations retain their provenance and do not become fresh acceptance merely by resuming a conversation.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Development：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm pack --dry-run
```

The unit tests exercise the existing state, evidence, coordination, and check mechanisms. The separate installed-host smoke test uses fixed responses and blocks provider dispatch; see [validation](docs/validation.md). There is no claimed general improvement in task success, speed, or cost. Run comparative model trials separately when evaluating those outcomes.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Development：The runtime files are under `lib/` and `modes/`. The root entry registers only Flow Next. The research benchmark panel, personal feedback records, model experiments, and project transcripts are excluded from this distribution. Runtime utility names such as `telemetry.js` describe local parsing helpers; this bundle does not mount the research collector or configure a remote reporting destination. DSH itself retains its own data and telemetry settings.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Distribution：This package uses the official `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest and a Cordis patch. The repository is tagged `dsh-plugin` for community discovery. Its [custom market index](marketplace/index.json) follows DSH's documented format and pins install sources to Git commits; add the raw index URL under **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** after enabling **Custom plugin markets**.

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next/main/marketplace/index.json
```

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Distribution：The index also lists the companion [Ambitious Prompt](https://github.com/sonwe1e/ambitious-prompt) skill bundle. The index is a community-maintained source, with no claim of official review or endorsement. Native mode functionality requires DSH; copying these files into another agent's skills directory does not reproduce the runtime mechanisms.

@sonwe1e/dsh-flow-next README · Distribution：References: [official plugin bundles](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/README.md), [official custom market format](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.md), [community contribution guidance](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
